component_state_rows.evidence_summary: Official MFU is a learned ConvTranspose2d/RB pyramid over decoder embed_list; local MFU is a deterministic NumPy LF feature bank with pooled, gradient, and patch bases.
Official HFR is three learned ConvBlock detail heads fed by pyr_out; local HFR is deterministic LF-edge correction added to stored or generated detail subbands.
Local TUB exposes the official Haar lowpass divided by two algebra, but it does not implement the official temporal encoders or output_2 decoder fusion graph.

next_actions: implement source-forward official MFU/HFR/TUB behavior proof or explicitly supersede it with same-axis receiver evidence

official_marker_group_rows.description: Official SNeRV analyzes LF/HF with Haar DWT and reconstructs with IDWT.
Official SNeRV fuses multi-resolution decoder embeddings before the LF/HF heads.
Official SNeRV predicts LH/HL/HH heads from the fused pyramid output.
Official SNeRV_T binds neighbor-frame temporal DWT features into the decoder.
Official training solves fc_dim from --modelsize and the parameter budget.
Official training exposes separate model and embedding quantization controls.
